name: application-volunteer-shift-card
title: Volunteer Shift Card
description: Volunteer shift card with role, date/time, a spots-filled progress bar, and a sign-up action, computed from real spotsFilled/spotsTotal props.
useWhen: Listing volunteer shifts or events with limited capacity that supporters can sign up for.
You want the spots-remaining count and progress bar to always agree with the underlying filled/total numbers.
The shift can fill up and you need a clear full/disabled end state on the sign-up action.
avoidWhen: You need a generic appointment or reservation slot with no capacity tracking — use `appointment-slot-card` for that instead.
Multiple shifts need to be compared in a dense table — this card is sized for a grid of a few shifts, not a data table.
There's no capacity limit at all — drop the progress bar and use a simpler event card.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width card (max-w-sm) that stacks full-width in narrow containers; progress bar and text row scale with the card width.
accessibility: Progress bar fill percentage and the 'left' count are both derived from the same spotsFilled/spotsTotal values, so they can never disagree.
Capacity is conveyed as text ('X of Y spots filled', 'N left') in addition to the visual bar, never by color or bar length alone.
The sign-up button is a real disabled <button> with updated label text when the shift is full, not just a visual dimming.

variants.title: Volunteer Shift Card
variants.description: Food bank sorting shift, 6 of 8 spots filled, 2 spots left, active sign-up button.
accessibility: Spots-left text and progress bar width are both computed from the same spotsFilled/spotsTotal props.

variants.title: Volunteer Shift Card (Dark)
variants.description: Volunteer shift card adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Progress bar and text colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
